title: Tractian raises $130M
caption:
Tractian, which uses sensors and AI to monitor critical industrial machines and catch failures early, raised a $130 million Series D at a $1.4 billion valuation, led by Sapphire Ventures and co-led by M&G's Catalyst. Its sensors track vibration, ultrasound and other signals, and its AI diagnoses root causes and recommends fixes. More than 2,000 critical facilities use it, and customers include Eli Lilly, McKesson, Whirlpool, Cummins and Embraer, it says.

FUN FACT: CEO Igor Marinelli grew up watching his father work as a maintenance technician at a paper mill.

FOUNDERS: Igor Marinelli (CEO), Gabriel Lameirinhas, Leonardo Vieira

INVESTORS: Sapphire Ventures, M&G's Catalyst, N47, General Catalyst, Bosch Ventures, 53 Stations, Monashees, Endeavor Catalyst, Norte Ventures, Y Combinator

AMOUNT: $130,000,000

TRACTION: More than 2,000 critical facilities, 700+ employees, headquartered in Atlanta
